data.title: 提弗洛斯 · 壁炉软毯边轻述萨米旧事
data.action: 盘腿坐在壁炉前毛毯上翻开旧笔记本轻声讲述
data.lighting: 温暖跃动的壁炉橙红火光映亮侧脸
data.description: 木柴在石砌壁炉里发出细碎的噼啪声。提弗洛斯盘腿坐在厚实的编织毛毯上，膝头摊开一本贴满雪松干叶的旧笔记本，橙红火光映在她粉紫色的眼底。她压低嗓音，像萨米老猎人那样娓娓道来风雪深处的古老传闻。
data.promptProse: Sitting cross-legged on a woven rug in front of a crackling stone fireplace, Typhoeus rests an open field notebook across her lap and looks up at the viewer with warm firelight dancing across her face.
data.animaCaption: She sits on a woven rug before the warm glow of the fireplace with an open notebook on her lap, speaking softly to the viewer.
